<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<wsdl:definitions xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/soap/" xmlns:xrd="http://x-road.eu/xsd/x-road.xsd" xmlns:tns="http://acl-parity.test/producer" xmlns:wsdl="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/" name="aclParity" targetNamespace="http://acl-parity.test/producer">
  <wsdl:message name="request"/>
  <wsdl:message name="response"/>
  <wsdl:portType name="aclParityPort">
    <wsdl:operation name="{{request.query.code}}">
      <wsdl:input message="tns:request"/>
      <wsdl:output message="tns:response"/>
    </wsdl:operation>
  </wsdl:portType>
  <wsdl:binding name="aclParityBindingV1" type="tns:aclParityPort">
    <soap:binding style="document" transport="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/http"/>
    <wsdl:operation name="{{request.query.code}}">
      <soap:operation soapAction="" style="document"/>
      <xrd:version>v1</xrd:version>
      <wsdl:input><soap:body use="literal"/></wsdl:input>
      <wsdl:output><soap:body use="literal"/></wsdl:output>
    </wsdl:operation>
  </wsdl:binding>
  <wsdl:binding name="aclParityBindingV2" type="tns:aclParityPort">
    <soap:binding style="document" transport="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/http"/>
    <wsdl:operation name="{{request.query.code}}">
      <soap:operation soapAction="" style="document"/>
      <xrd:version>v2</xrd:version>
      <wsdl:input><soap:body use="literal"/></wsdl:input>
      <wsdl:output><soap:body use="literal"/></wsdl:output>
    </wsdl:operation>
  </wsdl:binding>
  <wsdl:service name="aclParityService">
    <wsdl:port binding="tns:aclParityBindingV1" name="aclParityPortV1">
      <soap:address location="http://isrest:8080/acl-parity/soap/{{request.query.code}}"/>
    </wsdl:port>
    <wsdl:port binding="tns:aclParityBindingV2" name="aclParityPortV2">
      <soap:address location="http://isrest:8080/acl-parity/soap/{{request.query.code}}"/>
    </wsdl:port>
  </wsdl:service>
</wsdl:definitions>
